name: Dark Side of the Ring
description: Finding truth at the intersection of fantasy and reality in the veiled world of professional wrestling.

videos.title: The Match Made in Heaven
videos.overview: Art collides with real life when the mythical love story between wrestling icons Randy Savage and Miss Elizabeth explodes beyond the ring with tragic consequences.

videos.title: The Montreal Screwjob
videos.overview: In one of wrestling's most infamous off-script moments, wrestler Bret Hart is stripped of his championship title through a backstage plot of betrayal that forever changes the sport.

videos.title: The Killing of Bruiser Brody
videos.overview: Wrestlers discuss the tragic evening in 1988 when they witnessed a locker room confrontation that resulted in the death of legendary wrestler Bruiser Brody.

videos.title: The Last of the Von Erichs
videos.overview: The last surviving brother of the legendary Von Erich wrestling dynasty revisits the tragedy that plagued his once iconic family

videos.title: The Mysterious Death of Gorgeous Gino
videos.overview: New revelations about her son's death are revealed to the mother of wrestling star Gino Hernandez, whose 1986 death was believed to be a drug-related murder.

videos.title: The Fabulous Moolah
videos.overview: The legacy of wrestling's biggest female star, The Fabulous Moolah, is re-examined after controversial allegations surface following her 2007 death.

videos.title: Benoit Part One
videos.overview: In 2007, wrestling superstar Chris Benoit murders his wife and 7-year-old son, then ends his own life; those closest to the tragedy never speak openly until now.

videos.title: Benoit Part Two
videos.overview: The conclusion to wrestling's darkest hour, including startling revelations about the troubled mind of Chris Benoit before he killed his wife and son, and then took his own life.

videos.title: The Life and Crimes of New Jack
videos.overview: One of the most feared and controversial wrestlers of all time, New Jack's career reads like a criminal rap sheet; revealing the man behind the monster and his hardcore legacy

videos.title: The Brawl For All
videos.overview: Known as the worst idea in the history of professional wrestling, a legitimate boxing tournament leads to career-ending injuries and has audiences begging for the final bell.

videos.title: Jimmy Snuka and the Death of Nancy Argentino
videos.overview: Investigating the mysterious story of Jimmy Snuka, whose girlfriend Nancy Argentino died in their motel room in 1983, and revealing her family's 30-year struggle for justice.

videos.title: The Assassination of Dino Bravo
videos.overview: Family and friends of Dino Bravo relive his descent from Montreal's favorite wrestling son to mob enforcer, and the deadly consequences that followed.

videos.title: David Schultz & the Slap Heard Round the World
videos.overview: The cautionary tale of David Schultz, set to become a superstar until his violent run-in with "20/20" reporter John Stossel saw him exiled from the business he'd sworn to protect.

videos.title: Cocaine & Cowboy Boots: The Herb Abrams Story
videos.overview: One man's fanatical attempt to build a wrestling empire to rival Vince McMahon's goes tragically haywire as his ego and cocaine addiction kills his dream -- and him along with it.

videos.title: The Last Ride of the Road Warriors
videos.overview: The inside story of how wrestling's ultimate tag-team partnership is undone when one half of the powerhouse duo slides into alcohol and substance abuse.

videos.title: The Final Days of Owen Hart
videos.overview: In 1999, Owen Hart fell 80 feet to his death in a stunt that went tragically wrong. Bravely reliving his final day, his widow Martha reveals the mistakes that took his life.

videos.title: Brian Pillman Part One
videos.overview: Brian Pillman clawed his way to infamy with a groundbreaking performance that blurred the lines between fact and fiction until it led to his ultimate destruction.

videos.title: Brian Pillman Part Two
videos.overview: After enduring a horrific car wreck, Brian Pillman masks his injuries while pushing his body to the brink. His untimely death leaves his young family struggling to cope.

videos.title: The Ultra-Violence of Nick Gage
videos.overview: Nick Gage is the self-proclaimed king of deathmatch wrestling, but his road to the top has been marked with a six-year prison sentence for armed robbery and personal tragedies.

videos.title: Collision in Korea
videos.overview: In one of the most bizarre acts of political theatre ever conceived, professional wrestlers deployed to North Korea faced a terrifying ordeal that had them fighting for their lives.

videos.title: Becoming Warrior
videos.overview: The Ultimate Warrior was a divisive force in and outside of the ring. His first wife reveals how an aspiring chiropractor morphed himself into wrestling's most polarizing figure.

videos.title: In The Shadow of Grizzly Smith
videos.overview: Having survived familial abuse at the hands of their father and the mysterious abduction of their sister, Jake "The Snake" and his siblings struggle to reconcile with their past.

videos.title: The Dynamite Kid
videos.overview: The Dynamite Kid earned worldwide fame with a riveting, self-sacrificing style, but violent confrontations outside the ring would destroy his family, his body and his legacy.

videos.title: The Plane Ride From Hell
videos.overview: A private 757 flight descended into a nightmare as intoxicated wrestlers clashed with their flight crew, erupting into one of wrestling’s most infamous scandals.

videos.title: The Double Life of Chris Kanyon
videos.overview: In a culture that celebrates machismo and negative gay stereotypes, wrestling innovator Chris Kanyon kept his own sexuality a closely guarded secret for decades.

videos.title: Blood & Wire: Onita's FMW
videos.overview: After Japan's Atsushi Onita creates FMW and its spectacular matches featuring explosions and gratuitous gore, his handpicked successor takes his own life while drowning in debt.

videos.title: Bikers, Bombs & Bedlam: Johnny K9
videos.overview: Johnny K9 led a double life as an in-ring brute and the leader of a biker gang implicated in drug trafficking, the bombing of a police station, and a gruesome double murder.

videos.title: The Many Faces of Luna Vachon
videos.overview: A striking villain in the ring, Luna Vachon was a groundbreaking physical performer who battled mental illness and addiction while seeking to champion women's wrestling.

videos.title: Extreme & Obscene: Rob Black's XPW
videos.overview: XPW merged Rob Black's passions for hardcore porn and deathmatch wrestling, but after he waged a war with federal authorities his empire imploded.

videos.title: The Steroid Trials
videos.overview: In the mid 90s, wrestling was rocked by accusations of rampant steroid abuse. With star witness Hulk Hogan, prosecutors set out to prove that Vince McMahon was the one responsible.

videos.title: Chris and Tammy
videos.overview: Chris Candido and Tammy Sytch were high school sweethearts whose talent and ambition had them on a path to wrestling stardom. Along the way, drugs, injuries, and ill-fated choices sent them down another road altogether.

videos.title: Shattered: The Magnum T.A. Story
videos.overview: Wrestling hearththrob Terry Magnum T.A. Allen was destined for worldwide stardom, but one rainy night altered his career and the future of wrestling forever.

videos.title: Breaking the Cycle: The Graham Dynasty
videos.overview: Florida became a wrestling mecca for decades under patriarch Eddie Graham and his son Mike, but a series of shocking and unrelenting tragedies threatened to eclipse their legacy.

videos.title: What Happened to Doink the Clown?
videos.overview: Matt Borne, the man behind Doink the Clown, lived a life of unhinged violence and substance abuse until his shocking death left his family questioning if it really was an accident.

videos.title: The Junkyard Dog
videos.overview: One of the first Black megastars in wrestling, the Junkyard Dog's journey to the top of the business is marked by addiction and unrealized potential.

videos.title: The Tragic Fall of Adrian Adonis
videos.overview: A real life street fighter, Adrian Adonis turns flamboyant wrestling heel, but his life cuts short in an horrific accident that has been shrouded in mystery for the past thirty years.

videos.title: Abdullah the Butcher: Legacy of Blood
videos.overview: Infamous for his in-ring bloodbaths, Abdullah the Butcher was a money-making phenomenon. But after fifty years of pushing boundaries, one cut cost him everything.

videos.title: Bam Bam Bigelow: The Beast from the East
videos.overview: Convict; bounty hunter; flame-skulled wrestling legend; addict; the lore of Bam Bam Bigelow has only grown since his death; his family tells his improbable tale for the first time.

videos.title: Bash at the Beach 2000
videos.overview: At the end of the '90s, WCW's greatest battles played out backstage between scheming executives and writers, until one off-script rant against Hulk Hogan changed everything.

videos.title: The World According to Marty Jannetty
videos.overview: Known for their raw athleticism and sex appeal, Shawn Michaels and Marty Jannetty's run as The Rockers was eclipsed by Marty's excess, drug abuse, and possible murder.

videos.title: The Ballad of 'Earthquake' John Tenta
videos.overview: John Tenta couldn't be further from the monstrous Earthquake character WWF fans loved to hate; as his career faded, a health battle threatened to take him from the family he loved.

videos.title: Buff and the Bagwells
videos.overview: Marcus "Buff" Bagwell's brash persona in the ring was easily matched by his wild antics outside of it, made even wilder by the eccentric family he brought along for the ride.

videos.title: Terry Gordy: Final Flight of the Freebird
videos.overview: Already a wrestling star as a teenager, Terry Gordy's time with the renowned Fabulous Freebirds made him a living legend until an accidental overdose robbed him of everything.

videos.title: Saving Face: The Brutus Beefcake Story
videos.overview: Brutus 'The Barber' Beefcake's path in the wrestling world was defined by his decades-long friendship with Hulk Hogan and a horrifying accident that almost took his life.

videos.title: The Life and Legends of Harley Race
videos.overview: Harley Race achieved near mythical status for wrestling fans as the ultimate tough guy, but behind closed doors his life was haunted by violence and unimaginable personal tragedy.

videos.title: Chris Colt: Welcome to My Nightmare
videos.overview: The wildest wrestler never to break through, Chris Colt’s life took him from LSD trips in the ring to the world of porn but his self-destructive ways kept him from becoming a star.

videos.title: Chris Adams: The Gentleman and the Demon
videos.overview: 'Gentleman' Chris Adams had the charm, prowess and instinct to become a wrestling sensation, but a violent relationship with alcohol led to a tragic end at the hands of a friend.

videos.title: Sensational Sherri
videos.overview: An icon of the 80s and 90s as the 'Sensational' manager of top wrestling stars, Sherri Martel left her family behind to pursue her dreams in the ring.

videos.title: Enter Sandman: Legacy of a Hardcore Icon
videos.overview: A legend of hardcore wrestling, The Sandman made his mark in ECW as the ultimate beer-chugging dirtbag — but lines are blurred when his real family is brought into the ring.

videos.title: Black Saturday: The Rise of Vince
videos.overview: The day that has gone down in infamy as the launch of Vince McMahon’s absolute takeover of the professional wrestling industry, Black Saturday changed wrestling forever.

videos.title: Mick Foley: Hell in a Cell
videos.overview: From the first terrifying fall off the cage to the impact he still feels today, Mick Foley relives one of wrestling’s most iconic matches, Hell in a Cell ‘98 moment by moment.

videos.title: Ludvig Borga: Hellraiser from Helsinki
videos.overview: A Finnish wrestling bad guy turned real-life racist politician, Tony Halme’s time in the WWF as Ludvig Borga is only the start of his chaotic and destructive life.

videos.title: Big Van Vader
videos.overview: With an iconic look and skills few of his size could match, Big Van Vader stood out as a wrestling monster but controlling his anger became a bigger battle in and out of the ring.

videos.title: Tony Atlas: Too Much, Too Soon
videos.overview: With the physique of an Adonis and endless charisma, Tony Atlas made his mark as one of wrestling’s first Black stars but racism, addiction and ego kept Mr. USA from the top.

videos.title: The Original "Superstar": Billy Graham
videos.overview: Often imitated, never duplicated, Superstar Billy Graham broke the mold for what a wrestler could be but steroid abuse and battles with the McMahons kept Graham from the spotlight.

videos.title: “Hot Stuff” Eddie Gilbert
videos.overview: Skilled as a performer in the ring and as a booker, who created storylines behind the scenes. ‘Hot Stuff’ Eddie Gilbert was a ticking timebomb of talent and self-destruction.

videos.title: Truth, Lies and Billy Jack Haynes
videos.overview: An 80’s wrestling star, Billy Jack Haynes’ life of violence and mystery has led to his current situation—behind bars and charged with the second degree murder of his wife.

videos.title: Blood, Fire and the Original Sheik
videos.overview: One of the most hated heels in wrestling history; The Sheik, whose violent career spanned 50 years is revealed by his family and the few who survived his hardcore bloodbaths.

videos.title: The Scream Queen: Daffney
videos.overview: With her piercing scream, Shannon Spruill became a cult star as Daffney in the squared circle. Outside the ring, Daffney fought a much more punishing battle with bipolar disorder.

videos.title: Becoming Muhammad Hassan
videos.overview: Just three years post-9/11, Marc Copani sees the highs and lows of wrestling when he’s given the chance to portray Muhammad Hassan, a villainous Arab-American character for the WWE.

videos.title: Jeff Jarrett & The Battle for TNA Part 1
videos.overview: Born into wrestling, Jeff Jarrett builds Total Nonstop Action Wrestling from scratch, battling the WWE through a decade of success and controversy.

videos.title: Jeff Jarrett & The Battle for TNA Part 2
videos.overview: As Total Nonstop Action Wrestling grows, Jeff Jarrett faces internal chaos, power struggles, and scandal.

videos.title: Jeff Jarrett & The Battle for TNA Part 3
videos.overview: Exiled from the company he built, Jeff Jarrett battles alcoholism, enters rehab, and fights for redemption.

videos.title: Necro Butcher vs. Samoa Joe
videos.overview: In 2005, hardcore brawler Necro Butcher faced powerhouse Samoa Joe in a brutally savage match that became one of indie wrestling’s most infamous.

videos.title: The Big Boss Man
videos.overview: From prison guard to WWF star, Ray Traylor became the Big Boss Man, while behind the persona he battled pain and addiction.
